function.arguments: {"index": 3, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The data dictionary states that assay_batch B reports in µg/L, not ng/mL, and that 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL, so batch-B `biomarker_final` values are 10× too large. To verify this, I computed the mean `biomarker_final` for each assay batch: batch A has a mean of 40.29 ng/mL, batch B has a mean of 400.24 ng/mL. The ratio of batch B to batch A is approximately 9.93, which is very close to 10. This strongly supports the documentation claim that batch B values are in µg/L and must be divided by 10 to convert to ng/mL. Therefore, the correction is justified by the data and not merely assumed."}
function.name: resolve_finding
